summary.business_type: B2B Wholesale Textile Brokerage & Commission Agency (Adat)

top_findings.title: Critical Canonical Domain Mismatch
top_findings.impact: Every page on sunrisefabtex.com specifies rel="canonical" href="https://maasheetla.com/...". Search engines (Google/Bing) treat sunrisefabtex.com as duplicate content and drop it from search results.

top_findings.title: XML Sitemap Points to Sister Domain
top_findings.impact: https://sunrisefabtex.com/sitemap.xml contains 10 URLs all pointing to https://maasheetla.com. There are zero sunrisefabtex.com URLs in the sitemap.

top_findings.title: Robots.txt Host & Sitemap Directive Mismatch
top_findings.impact: robots.txt explicitly declares Host: https://maasheetla.com and Sitemap: https://maasheetla.com/sitemap.xml.

top_findings.title: AI Search Engine Bots Blocked by Cloudflare
top_findings.impact: Cloudflare Managed AI Scraper Protection blocks GPTBot, ClaudeBot, and Google-Extended, preventing AI search engines (ChatGPT Search, Claude) from referencing the site.

top_findings.title: Title Tags Exceed Character Limits (SERP Truncation)
top_findings.impact: 9 out of 10 pages have <title> tags exceeding 65 characters (e.g. /about is 107 characters), causing ellipsis truncation in Google search results.

quick_wins: Dynamic canonical URL generator based on request hostname (or environment variable).
Dynamic sitemap.xml and robots.txt host declaration for sunrisefabtex.com.
Trim title tags to 55-60 characters with ' | Sunrise Fab Tex' branding.
Compress meta descriptions on /about and /contact to 140-155 characters.
Add llms.txt file to root for AI engine citation and discovery.

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Flawless HTTP to HTTPS redirection.
Enterprise-grade security headers (HSTS preload 1-year, CSP, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy).
Fast global edge delivery via Cloudflare Pages (sub-50ms TTFB).
Next.js static pre-rendering (SSG) with zero SSR lag.
PII protection: /admin/ and /api/ cleanly disallowed in robots.txt.

findings.title: Canonical Tag Points to External Domain
findings.description: On https://sunrisefabtex.com/, the canonical link tag is hardcoded in layout.tsx to https://maasheetla.com. This causes Google to attribute 100% of indexation signals to maasheetla.com, causing sunrisefabtex.com to be de-indexed as a duplicate.
findings.recommendation: Update metadataBase and alternates.canonical in layout.tsx and individual pages to support sunrisefabtex.com.

findings.title: Sitemap.xml contains zero sunrisefabtex.com URLs
findings.description: sitemap.ts hardcodes const baseUrl = 'https://maasheetla.com', so visiting https://sunrisefabtex.com/sitemap.xml serves URLs for maasheetla.com.
findings.recommendation: Use environment variable or dynamic host detection in sitemap.ts.

findings.title: Robots.txt Host directive mismatch
findings.description: robots.ts specifies Host: https://maasheetla.com and Sitemap: https://maasheetla.com/sitemap.xml.

categories.name: Content Quality & E-E-A-T
what_works: Exceptional word depth: 2,515 words on homepage, 1,245 on commercial desk, 1,420 on craft page.
Authentic industry vocabulary (Adat, Loom Rates, Dola Silk, Tissue Organza, Salabatpura).
Complete physical E-E-A-T credentials with 3 physical addresses (Surat, Kanpur, Ahmedabad).
Named founder (Manish Kanodia) with 18-year heritage timeline (2008–2026).
Zero thin content pages across the entire site.

findings.title: Meta description length exceeds 160 characters on 3 pages
findings.recommendation: Trim to 145-155 characters for optimal snippet presentation in mobile SERPs.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: 100% of pages have exactly one <h1> tag.
Logical heading hierarchy (H1 -> H2 -> H3) with keyword relevance.
Rich internal cross-linking between trading desks, firm profiles, and onboarding.

findings.title: Page Titles Exceeding 60 Characters
findings.description: 9 out of 10 pages exceed Google's 60-character desktop display threshold (e.g. /about is 107 characters: 'Our Story & Heritage (2008–2026) - Maa Sheetla Agency & Sunrise Fab Tex (Adat) | Maa Sheetla Agency').
findings.recommendation: Shorten titles to concise high-intent phrases: e.g. 'Our Story & Heritage (2008–2026) | Sunrise Fab Tex'.

findings.title: Open Graph og:url and og:site_name mismatch
findings.description: og:url points to https://maasheetla.com on sunrisefabtex.com. Social cards shared from sunrisefabtex.com resolve to maasheetla.com.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Comprehensive JSON-LD graph with Organization, WholesaleStore (3 locations), WebSite, and FAQPage.
Valid GeoCoordinates (Surat: 21.1895, 72.8436; Kanpur: 26.4719, 80.3496; Ahmedabad: 23.0189, 72.5976).
Opening hours specifications and contact telephones included.
FAQPage schema targeting wholesale broker queries.

findings.title: Schema @id and url property mismatch
findings.description: All schema IDs use https://maasheetla.com/#organization. For sunrisefabtex.com, it should include sameAs or dynamic IDs.

findings.title: Missing BreadcrumbList Schema
findings.description: Inner pages (/sunrise-fab-tex, /about, /partner) lack BreadcrumbList markup for enhanced rich snippets.

categories.name: Performance (Core Web Vitals)
what_works: Preloaded critical LCP images (hero logos).
Preconnected Google Fonts CDN.
Zero server-side rendering delay (Cloudflare Edge SSG).
Clean CSS footprint with Tailwind utility classes.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Highly structured and tabular data perfect for LLM knowledge extraction.

findings.title: Robots.txt Blocks AI Search Crawlers
findings.description: Cloudflare default rules block GPTBot, ClaudeBot, Bytespider, and Google-Extended, preventing AI search engines from indexing the site for live responses.
findings.recommendation: Whitelist or allow GPTBot and ClaudeBot for citation access in Cloudflare security settings.

findings.title: Missing llms.txt File
findings.recommendation: Deploy a concise /public/llms.txt summarizing company services, desk phone numbers, and trade locations.

categories.name: Images
what_works: 100% of images across all audited pages have meaningful alt tags (0 missing).
Logos are appropriately sized with width/height attributes preventing CLS.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Indexation Unblocking (Day 1)
items: Fix Canonical Tags: Stop pointing sunrisefabtex.com to maasheetla.com.
Fix sitemap.xml: Generate sunrisefabtex.com URLs in the sitemap.
Fix robots.txt: Set Host: https://sunrisefabtex.com and Sitemap: https://sunrisefabtex.com/sitemap.xml.

phases.name: Phase 2: SERP Display & Click-Through Optimization (Week 1)
items: Optimize Title Tags: Shorten /about, /sunrise-fab-tex, /partner, /contact to <60 chars.
Adjust Meta Descriptions: Shorten descriptions on /about and /contact to <155 chars.
Fix Open Graph tags: Set og:url to sunrisefabtex.com.

phases.name: Phase 3: AI Search & Rich Snippet Expansion (Week 2)
items: Adjust Cloudflare AI scraper settings to allow search crawlers (GPTBot/ClaudeBot).
Add BreadcrumbList structured data to inner pages.
